insight: Deploys to your own Vercel in a click, and its 'beam' feature runs one prompt across several models to compare side by side.
name: Big-AGI
tagline: Multi-model AI workspace with chat, voice, image gen, and tool use — BYO keys.
description: A self-hostable AI workspace for chatting across hundreds of models from many providers, with voice calls, image generation, web search, and code execution. It runs self-hosted via Docker or Vercel and connects to local engines (Ollama, LM Studio, LocalAI) as well as cloud providers. MIT-licensed and free — you supply your own provider API keys.

modelSupport.notes: Hundreds of models across providers incl. local engines and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
